summary: The document represents a user control in an ASP.NET application, specifically designed to generate reports related to student assignment summaries. It includes various controls for user input and display, including checkboxes, drop-down lists, radio buttons, and labels.
purpose: To facilitate the generation and customization of student assignment summary reports within the HSPnet application.

workflows.name: Report Generation
steps: Page_Load sets up interface texts and error messages.
Page_PreRender fetches and displays descriptions and options from code repository.
User input through controls like checkboxes and drop-down lists.
cmdRunReport_Click initiates report generation with various user-selected parameters.

business_rules: Javascript setup is conditional on async postbacks.
Department dropdown list populated based on user session and agency constraints.
Program dropdown list populated based on user session and department constraints.
Cohort dropdown list to be filled based on program selection.
validations: CustomValidator1 and CustomValidator2 ensure report constraints are met before generation.
ValidationSummary1 collects validation errors for user display.
conditions: UserSession must be active to interact with controls.
cmdRunReport_Click operates based on user-selected PDF and contact information options.
system_behavior: Controls are auto-generated and modifications are suggested to be done in code-behind files.
Dropdowns dynamically populated based on user data.
Report generation is a server-side process involving user session data.
exceptions: Session null states prevent certain data actions using ObjectDataSourceSelecting.
